name: Elastic Glitch Slider
description: Draggable step slider whose knob is three overlapping CMYK-colored bubbles that follow with different elastic delays, while the track stretches and snaps around it.
contents: Horizontal track split in two bars around the knob
Knob made of three multiply-blended colored circles
behavior: Plays an intro sweep from the initial step to step 5 and then step 1
Click or drag on the track moves the knob with staggered elastic easing
Track bars shrink and stretch with the knob position
Calls onChange with the nearest step number
Works with mouse and touch through pointer events
editableByProps: Slider width, track thickness and knob size
Knob bubble colors and track color
Number of steps and starting step

needsCodeEdit.change: Remove or change the intro sweep
needsCodeEdit.where: timer1 and timer2 setTimeout calls in the useEffect

needsCodeEdit.change: Adjust elastic timing of each bubble
needsCodeEdit.where: gsap.to calls for yellowRef, magentaRef and cyanRef in changeStep

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Intro sweep to step 5 then step 1 always plays on mount
Page background is not set, the host controls it
